newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, but demand slight.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, but demand slight.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were edging lower on Monday, pressured by a lack of enquiries.
Sellers earlier quoted 380-cst at $125 per tonne, but eased to $124 later to meet buyer's levels. Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $129-$130, one dollar lower on the offer.
Sellers said most shipowners were relaxed and sought supplies for loading starting January 6. "We have a few sellers calling at the same time today," said a shipowner.
MDO and gas oil were steady at $231-$245, $255-$262 respectively.
